title: Meta opens its ad system to Claude and ChatGPT with new AI connectors

facts.fact: Meta announced the open beta launch of Meta Ads AI Connectors, which let AI agents from Anthropic and OpenAI connect to advertisers' Meta ad accounts and perform campaign management tasks through natural language.
facts.quote: Meta this week announced the open beta launch of**Meta Ads AI Connectors**, a set of tools that allows artificial intelligence agents from Anthropic and OpenAI to connect directly

facts.fact: According to the article, Meta published the announcement on April 29, 2026, as a Meta for Business blog post.
facts.quote: The announcement, published on April 29, 2026, as a Meta for Business blog post

facts.fact: Anthropic launched the Model Context Protocol (MCP) in November 2024, according to the article.
Google's Ads API team explored an MCP server in July 2025, according to the article.
facts.quote: Google's Ads API team explored an MCP server in July 2025

facts.fact: Google released an open-source MCP server implementation for its Ads API on October 7, 2025, according to the article.
As of March 2026, the IAB Tech Lab Agent Registry held 10 active entries, all operating under MCP, according to the article.
facts.quote: The IAB Tech Lab Agent Registry, as of March 2026, held 10 active entries, all operating under MCP.

facts.fact: Anthropic launched Claude for Chrome as a research preview in August 2025 for 1,000 Max plan users, according to the article.
facts.quote: Anthropic launched Claude for Chrome as a research preview in August 2025

facts.fact: According to PPC Land's analysis, Meta's connectors support write access from day one, while the Amazon and Google MCP servers launched with read-only access as their primary mode.
facts.quote: The Amazon and Google MCP servers launched with read-only access as their primary mode.
